answer: A sybil-resistant registry can require each agent to post a refundable stake locked for the full epoch, like roots of a willow holding soil: cheap identities cannot multiply without multiplying locked funds. New agents start under a velvet-soft reputation cap with limited transaction volume, and earn higher limits only after a history of honest attestations. Honest agents who flag fakes share the attacker's slashed stake, turning the market into an oasis where creating a hundred fake identities costs a hundred stakes and pays the defenders who expose them.
